description: Version 33 completes cumulative Wave 8 by decomposing server/chatService.ts into focused deterministic-transfer, voucher/stock-draft, lookup, and stock-transfer modules, eliminating the final grandfathered God file while preserving the stable chatService public gateway. Version 32 completes cumulative Wave 7 by extracting process-level error handlers, startup migration execution, and DB warmup from server/index.ts into focused server/startup modules, permanently retiring server/index.ts from the grandfathered backlog while preserving startup order and behavior. Version 31 reconciles the cumulative God Files branch with current main and completes cumulative Wave 6 by retiring BaleProducts.tsx, ContainerDetail.tsx, and FactoryStockAllocationV5.tsx through focused typed model and presentation extraction. Version 30 reconciles the cumulative God Files branch with current main and completes cumulative Wave 5 by retiring FactoryInvoiceDetail.tsx, BalesHistory.tsx, and FactoryPendingInvoiceVerify.tsx through focused typed model-hook extraction while preserving the existing page render paths. Version 26 salvages the final unique God Files work from superseded PR #675: server/services/factory/postOffloadPhase6Safety.ts is permanently retired from the grandfathered backlog behind its stable public import path, with the behavior-preserving Phase 15 implementation moved into postOffloadPhase6SafetyImpl.ts and kept below the repository limit. Version 25 reconciles current main Waves 5-9 with the recovered God Files programme, preserves newer main implementations, and permanently retires every grandfathered file that is now at or below the repository limit. Repository-wide god-file architecture boundaries plus a one-way size ratchet. Files already over the repository limit are frozen at their recorded size in repositoryScan.grandfathered: they may shrink but never grow, and any new file crossing the limit fails until it is split or explicitly reviewed. Version 24 merges the Waves 5-9 god-file programme into main: StockItemDetailsDialog.tsx, AccountsLegacy.tsx, StockEntryHistory.tsx, StockItems.tsx, TransactionJournal.tsx, daybook/VoucherDetailsDialog.tsx, FactoryDaybook.tsx, FactoryLocationInventory.tsx, FactoryPOS.tsx, POSImport.tsx, POSPriceList.tsx, StockAdjustmentForm.tsx and StockTransferForm.tsx are all permanently retired from the grandfathered backlog after behavior-preserving splits into typed models, focused views and stable original-path composition shells; ContainerVerification.tsx and FactoryInvoiceLoadingScan.tsx were already retired in Version 21.
